propositions: Snapshot-entry schema contract is hand-rolled in _snapshot_schema.py outside the central src/rebar/schemas/ machinery and is imported by no production module
Fetcher.py producer does not validate output against the snapshot schema despite ADR 0004 requiring schema-first updates
Snapshot schema encodes a parent present-vs-absent distinction that gates an inbound CLEAR data-destroying path
90 sibling schemas in src/rebar/schemas/ are automatically validated via generated-types drift gate but snapshot schema is not
Real fetcher output fixtures exist in bridge_state/snapshots/ but are gitignored and contain PII, requiring redacted test fixtures covering populated, parent-absent, and empty shapes
